sketches.mechanism: Move semantics for non-Copy values make the original binding unusable after ownership is transferred.
sketches.resonance: The code tries to keep what it has already given away, and the type system refuses the contradiction.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because it has no channel instance through which communication can occur.
sketches.resonance: A waiting gesture is syntactically valid, but the other side of the passage was never created.

sketches.mechanism: The Nothing type is a subtype of every type because expressions of that type never successfully return.
sketches.resonance: It can satisfy any promised form only by never becoming present.
